description: This file defines a Flutter application's routing configuration using the go_router package. It sets up public and protected routes, implements an auth guard based on secure storage token, and includes widgets for various screens such as login, registration, dashboard, and profile. It orchestrates navigation, including a bottom navigation bar, and incorporates route redirection logic for authentication states.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: Class responsible for setting up and managing application routing, including route definitions, navigation, and authentication guards.

classes.description: Placeholder screen representing the dashboard view.
